title: Claude in biology labs: Biomni, MozzareLLM, and others
summary: Anthropic describes three cases: Biomni (Stanford) completed a GWAS analysis in 20 minutes in an initial trial and suggested new transcription factors in embryonic development; MozzareLLM (MIT and Whitehead) interprets gene clusters from CRISPR screens; a third lab is still testing. This is an Anthropic account without independent evaluation; some figures are estimates.
